verdict.rationale: Luma's homepage says its Agents 'generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text,' so the same workspace claims some audio generation. Nothing documents sound effects, ambient audio, music, or audio matched to a generated scene. Lip-sync preservation in Modify Video concerns the source footage and is not audio generation, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented sound-effect, ambient, or music generation; scene-matched audio sync; audio controls or API endpoints; hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Agents research, generate, and refine across video, image, audio, and text
